title: IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Kit & Pod Bundle
description: This all-in-one setup combines the bestselling IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit with an additional IVG Pro prefilled refill pod. This exclusive bundle provides vapers with a reliable 1000mAh device and a total of 24ml of e-liquid right out of the box, ensuring enduring performance and uninterrupted satisfaction without the need for constant maintenance. The IVG Pro 12 features a built-in TFT screen to clearly display your battery level, alongside an optional Boost Mode that can be activated with a quick double-tap for more intense flavour production. IVG Pro pods utilise a smart auto-refill system where a 10ml reservoir continually feeds the 2ml pod, delivering up to 12,000 puffs per setup without the need for manual refilling or messy coil changes. Driven by advanced mesh coil technology, this pocket-friendly device provides a smooth and flavourful Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw. With the inclusion of an extra pod in this bundle, you can easily swap profiles to keep your experience fresh or simply enjoy double the longevity of your favourite flavour. Available Bundle Flavours: The IVG Pro 12 collection features over 30 expertly crafted profiles to suit any preference. Options range from refreshing, cool blends like Blue Raspberry Ice and Fresh Menthol Mojito, to vibrant tropical mixes such as Double Mango and Kiwi Passionfruit Guava. For those who prefer a sparkling twist, soda-inspired profiles like Pink Lemonade and Fizzy Cherry deliver a sweet and punchy vape. How To Set Up Your IVG Pro 12 Device Step 1 Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Step 2 Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Step 3 Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Step 4 Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Step 5 Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ Ready to vape
